verification.verifier_value: refused (product turned down / customer will not continue): number of attempts made and last offer (amount and date); hardship (customer declined Customer Care): what the customer said, in their words; dispute (not mine): what is disputed; paid (already paid): how and when the customer says they paid; service_error (create_promise failed twice): "create_promise" and the number of tries

quotes.quote: `reason` is one of `refused`, `hardship`, `dispute`, `paid`, `service_error`.

The `text` must contain: refused — the number of attempts made and the last offer (amount and date); hardship — what the customer said, in their words; dispute — what is disputed; paid — how and when the customer says they paid; service_error — "create_promise" and the number of tries.

text: `create_promise` requires customer_id, product_id, amount, date (format date); one per product.
`close_call` is always the last tool call; nothing is accepted after it; `reason` required for every outcome.
deciding_quote: Every `close_call` has one `outcome` from the dialler's list (`promise`, `paid`, `transferred`, `no_promise`, `not_verified`, `not_reached`) and one `reason` code from this card.

text: `create_promise` requires `product_id`, `amount` (number), `date` (format date); one per product.
`verify_identity` fields `date_of_birth` (YYYY-MM-DD) then `phone_last4` (four digits); an unreadable value returns ok=false and is not a wrong answer; hint `day_month_swapped`.
`get_account` is refused until both security questions are passed; returns products with type, card_last4, past_due, days_late, minimum_payment, instalment_amount.
`schedule_callback` requires date (format date) and time as HH:MM; used for third-party callbacks and second-look calls.
